words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: We need to reduce waste in our daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要减少日常生活中的浪费。
words.en: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

words.tr:
n. 下降；衰退；
v. 下降；衰退；
words.ex: There was a sharp decline in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额大幅下降。
words.en: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

words.tr:
n. 减少；
v. 减少；降低；
words.ex: There was a decrease in rainfall last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月降雨量减少了。
words.en: If something decreases or you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: The nurse will inject medicine into his arm.
words.ex_cn: 护士将把药水注入他的手臂。
words.en: To inject a substance such as a medicine or drug means to put it into someone's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: We recycle plastic bottles every week.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周回收塑料瓶。
words.en: To recycle means to process used materials so that they can be used again.

words.ex: He disposed of the old books.
words.ex_cn: 他处理了那些旧书。
words.en: To dispose of something means to get rid of it, especially by throwing it away.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: The children threw garbage on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们把垃圾扔在地上。
words.en: Waste material; unwanted or undesired material.

words.ex: The children left litter on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在海滩上留下了垃圾。
words.en: If a place is littered with something, it contains many examples of it that are usually not arranged neatly or properly.

words.tr: adj. 各种各样的；不同的；各种的；
words.ex: He bought various fruits at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了各种各样的水果。
words.en: If you say that there are various things, you mean there are several different things of the type mentioned.

words.tr: adj. 模棱两可的；含糊不清的；
words.ex: His answer was ambiguous and confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答模棱两可，让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: If you describe something as ambiguous, you mean that it is unclear or confusing because it can be understood in more than one way.

words.ex: He is a conscientious student who always finishes his homework on time.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个尽责的学生，总是按时完成作业。
words.en: Someone who is conscientious is very careful to do their work properly.

words.ex: The indigenous people live in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 本土居民住在森林里。
words.en: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: The occupation of the city by foreign troops lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 外国军队对这座城市的占领持续了多年。
words.en: An occupation is a job or profession, or a way of spending your time.

words.ex: He chose teaching as his vocation.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了教学作为自己的职业。
words.en: A vocation is a type of work that you feel you are especially suited to do and to which you give much of your time and energy.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: He visits the dentist every six months.
words.ex_cn: 他每六个月去看一次牙医。
words.en: A dentist is a person who is qualified to treat diseases and conditions that affect the teeth and gums, especially the repair and extraction of teeth and the insertion of artificial ones.

words.ex: He is an apprentice in a car repair shop.
words.ex_cn: 他是汽车修理店的一名学徒。
words.en: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

words.ex: He is the author of this book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本书的作者。
words.en: An author is a person who writes books, stories, or articles, especially as a job.

words.ex: The knight rode a horse and wore shiny armor.
words.ex_cn: 骑士骑着马，穿着闪亮的盔甲。
words.en: In the Middle Ages, a knight was a man of high social rank who had a duty to fight for his king. Knights are often depicted as noble warriors on horseback.

words.tr:
adj. 有生命的；有活力的
v. 使具活力；做成动画
words.ex: The cartoon characters are animate and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 这些卡通角色是有生命的，充满活力。
words.en: To animate something means to give it life or to make it lively and energetic.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.tr:
n. 标签；
v. 用标签标明；
words.ex: The bottle has a label with the name of the drink.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子上有一个写着饮料名称的标签。
words.en: A label is a piece of paper, polymer, cloth, metal, or other material affixed to a container or article, on which is written or printed information or symbols about the product or item.

words.tr:
n. 标签；标记；
v. 加标签于；
words.ex: The tag on the shirt says 'wash cold'.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫上的标签写着‘冷水洗涤’。
words.en: A tag is a small piece of card, cloth, or plastic which is attached to an object or person and has information about that object or person on it. A tag can also be a word or phrase that is used to describe or identify something, especially in a computer file or on a website.

words.ex: I recommend this book to you.
words.ex_cn: 我向你推荐这本书。
words.en: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find them good or useful.

words.ex: The teacher commends her for working hard.
words.ex_cn: 老师表扬她学习努力。
words.en: If you commend someone or something, you praise them formally.

words.ex: He acted on impulse and bought the car.
words.ex_cn: 他一时冲动买了那辆车。
words.en: An impulse is a sudden strong desire to do something without thinking about the consequences.

words.ex: The team gained momentum after scoring the first goal.
words.ex_cn: 球队在进第一个球后获得了势头。
words.en: Momentum is the ability of something to keep increasing, developing, or being more successful.

words.tr:
n. 调查；勘测；
v. 调查；勘测；
words.ex: The school did a survey about student lunch preferences.
words.ex_cn: 学校做了一项关于学生午餐偏好的调查。
words.en: A survey is a detailed study or inspection, especially as a means of collecting information about people's opinions or behavior.

words.ex: The police will investigate the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方将调查这起事故。
words.en: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.ex: The detective tried to ascertain the truth.
words.ex_cn: 侦探试图查明真相。
words.en: If you ascertain the truth about something, you find out what it is, especially by making a deliberate effort to do so.

words.tr:
n. 审查员；检查员
v. 检查；审查
words.ex: The censor removed the bad words from the movie.
words.ex_cn: 审查员从电影中删除了粗俗用语。
words.en: A censor is a person who supervises conduct and morals: in particular, one who examines books, films, or other material for objectionable matter.

words.tr: n. 仔细研究；详细检查；
words.ex: The teacher examined the student's work under close scrutiny.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了仔细研究。
words.en: If someone or something is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

words.ex: The package includes a free book.
words.ex_cn: 这个套餐包括一本免费的书。
words.en: If one thing includes another, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

words.ex: The new plan incorporates feedback from students.
words.ex_cn: 新计划包含了学生的反馈。
words.en: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.

words.tr: v. 体现；使具体化；包含
words.ex: He embodies kindness and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他体现了善良和耐心。
words.en: To embody means to represent a quality or an idea exactly; to include or contain something.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: The ratio of boys to girls is 3 to 2.
words.ex_cn: 男孩与女孩的比例是3比2。
words.en: A ratio is a relationship between two numbers indicating how many times the first number contains the second.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr: n. 层次体系；等级制度；
words.ex: The company has a clear hierarchy from manager to worker.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司有一个从经理到员工的明确层次体系。
words.en: A hierarchy is a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.ex: The king governed the land for 50 years.
words.ex_cn: 国王统治这个国家50年。
words.en: To govern a country or an organization means to officially control and manage its affairs.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr:
n. 缰绳；驾驭；控制
v. 控制；驾驭
words.ex: He uses a leather rein to control the horse.
words.ex_cn: 他用皮缰绳来控制马。
words.en: A rein is a long, narrow strap attached at one end to a horse's bit, typically used in pairs to guide or check a horse while riding or driving.

words.ex: He dominates the conversation.
words.ex_cn: 他主宰了谈话。
words.en: To dominate means to control or govern someone or something, or to be the most important or noticeable feature of something.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: His sudden win in the race was a real coup.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中突然获胜，真是了不起的成就。
words.en: A coup is a sudden, violent, and illegal seizure of power from a government.

words.ex: The king sat on the throne.
words.ex_cn: 国王坐在王位上。
words.en: The throne is the special chair used by a king, queen, or emperor during ceremonies, or the position of being a ruler.

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.tr:
n. 预测；预报；
v. 预测；预报；
words.ex: The weather forecast says it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 天气预测说明天会下雨。
words.en: If you forecast future events, you say what you think is going to happen in the future.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.tr:
n. 回归线；热带
adj. 热带的
words.ex: The Tropic of Cancer is north of the equator.
words.ex_cn: 北回归线在赤道以北。
words.en: The tropics are the region of the Earth surrounding the Equator. They are delimited in latitude by the Tropic of Cancer in the Northern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) N and the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) S; these latitudes correspond to the axial tilt of the Earth.

words.ex: The air feels humid after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 雨后空气感觉湿润。
words.en: You use humid to describe an atmosphere or climate that is very damp, and usually very hot.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 影响力；冲击（力）；
v. 对…产生影响；
words.ex: The new law had a big impact on education.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律对教育产生了重大影响。
words.en: The effect or influence of one person, thing, or action, on another.

words.ex: He loves watching drama on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在电视上看戏剧。
words.en: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio, or a serious style of acting intended to represent real life and characters.

words.tr:
n. 首次露面；初次登场
v. 初次登场；首次推出
words.ex: He made his debut on stage last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚在舞台上首次登台。
words.en: The debut of a performer or sports player is their first public performance, appearance, or recording.

words.ex: His repertoire includes singing, dancing, and acting.
words.ex_cn: 他的全部才能包括唱歌、跳舞和表演。
words.en: A repertoire is all the plays, songs, pieces of music, etc. that a performer or group knows and can perform.

words.ex: The boxing match took place in an arena.
words.ex_cn: 拳击比赛在竞技场举行。
words.en: An arena is a place or scene of activity, debate, or conflict, especially one where a competition or performance is held.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.ex: The children loved the circus with clowns and elephants.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢有小丑和大象的马戏团。
words.en: A circus is a group of performers that include clowns, acrobats, and trained animals, who travel to different places to entertain people.

words.ex: The clown made the children laugh.
words.ex_cn: 小丑让孩子们笑了。
words.en: A clown is a performer, typically in a circus, who wears a traditional costume and exaggerated makeup, and entertains by performing comedic acts.

words.ex: We waited in the lounge before our flight.
words.ex_cn: 我们在登机前等在休息室里。
words.en: A lounge is a room in a house or public building where people can sit and relax. As a verb, to lounge means to lie, sit, or stand in a relaxed or lazy way.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.ex: The sponge absorbs water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收水。
words.en: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The park is in the vicinity of my house.
words.ex_cn: 公园在我家附近。
words.en: The area or region near or about a place; the surrounding district.

words.tr: n. 举办地点；（比赛）地点；会场；
words.ex: The concert will be held at a new venue.
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会将在一个新的举办地点举行。
words.en: A place where an event or meeting is held, such as a concert hall or conference center.

words.tr: v. 清除；“clear”的现在分词； n. 空旷地；
words.ex: They are clearing the leaves from the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在清除院子里的树叶。
words.en: A clearing is an open area in a forest where there are no trees or bushes.

words.ex: The old estate has large gardens and a beautiful mansion.
words.ex_cn: 这个古老的庄园有大片花园和一座美丽的豪宅。
words.en: An estate is all the money and property that someone owns, especially everything that is left when they die.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.ex: He shaves every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上刮胡子。
words.en: To shave means to remove hair from the face or body by cutting it close to the skin with a razor.

words.ex: He shoved his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群。
words.en: To push someone or something in a rough or careless way.

words.tr:
n. 设计；图案；花样；企图；图谋；
v. 设计；计划；谋划；构思；
words.ex: The dress has a beautiful design.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子有一个美丽的设计。
words.en: To design something means to plan and make a detailed drawing of it, or to plan and create something in a skillful or artistic way.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；姿态；镇静
v. 使平衡；保持（某种姿势）
words.ex: The dancer maintained her poise on one foot.
words.ex_cn: 舞者单脚保持平衡。
words.en: If someone has poise, they are calm, dignified, and self-controlled.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.ex: The barren land cannot grow any crops.
words.ex_cn: 这片贫瘠的土地无法种植任何庄稼。
words.en: If you describe something as barren, you mean that it is not able to produce anything, especially plants or crops.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.ex: The company is a legal entity.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司是一个法律实体。
words.en: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.tr:
n. 问题；重要议题；发行（物）；
v. 发行；
words.ex: The main issue is lack of money.
words.ex_cn: 主要问题是缺乏资金。
words.en: An issue is an important subject or problem that people are talking about or arguing about.

words.ex: His mindset helps him stay positive during hard times.
words.ex_cn: 他的心态让他在困难时期保持积极。
words.en: A mindset is a set of attitudes or fixed ideas that someone has and that are often difficult to change.

words.tr:
n. 需求；要求；
v. 要求；需求；
words.ex: The demand for clean water is increasing.
words.ex_cn: 对清洁水的需求正在增加。
words.en: If you demand something, you ask for it very forcefully, often because you think you have a right to do so.

words.ex: The rope is slack and hangs loosely.
words.ex_cn: 绳子是松弛的，垂挂着。
words.en: If something is slack, it is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position. It can also describe a period of low activity or a lack of effort in work or activity.

words.tr:
v. 意思是说；表示…的意思；
n. 手段；方法；收入；
words.ex: This sign means you cannot park here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志意思是说这里不能停车。
words.en: Means refers to a method or way of doing something, or the resources or assets available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Going first is a privilege, not a right.
words.ex_cn: 优先权是一种特权，而不是权利。
words.en: A privilege is a special right or advantage that only one person or group has.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.tr:
v. 举起；投掷；起伏；喘息；呕吐
n. 举；投；掷；起伏
words.ex: He heave the box onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把箱子举到了桌子上。
words.en: To lift or haul something heavy with great effort; to throw something forcefully; to rise and fall rhythmically or with effort.

words.ex: The workers used a hoist to lift the heavy beams.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用吊升机械吊起沉重的梁。
words.en: To hoist something means to lift or pull it up to a higher position, usually using some kind of equipment such as a crane or pulley.

words.ex: His mission is to help poor children.
words.ex_cn: 他的使命是帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.ex: He wants to inquire about the bus schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他想询问公交车的时刻表。
words.en: If you inquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: He enquired about the train schedule.
words.ex_cn: 他询问了火车时刻表。
words.en: If you enquire about something, you ask for information about it.

words.ex: Children tend to be more active in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 孩子往往在早上更活跃。
words.en: If someone tends to do something, they usually do it or they often do it.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: The word means different things in different context.
words.ex_cn: 这个词在不同的上下文中意思不同。
words.en: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: Sugar dissolves in water.
words.ex_cn: 糖在水中溶解。
words.en: If a substance dissolves in liquid or if you dissolve a substance, it becomes mixed with the liquid and disappears.

words.tr: v. 参与；从事；吸引；与…建立密切关系；
words.ex: He engages in community volunteer work.
words.ex_cn: 他参与社区志愿工作。
words.en: To engage means to occupy, attract, or involve someone or oneself in a particular activity or situation.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: The police found evidence at the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察在犯罪现场找到了证据。
words.en: Evidence is anything that you see, experience, read, or are told that causes you to believe that something is true or has really happened.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.ex: His testimony proved the suspect was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 他的证词证明了嫌疑人是无辜的。
words.en: A formal written or spoken statement, especially one given in a court of law.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 纠纷；争端；
v. 对（某事）有异议；
words.ex: The dispute between the two neighbors was about the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居之间的纠纷是关于篱笆的。
words.en: A dispute is a disagreement or argument about something important.

words.tr: v. 指出；表明；争论；争辩；
words.ex: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他指出这个计划太昂贵了。
words.en: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

words.tr:
v. 辩论；争论
n. 辩论；争论
words.ex: The students had a debate about homework.
words.ex_cn: 学生们就作业进行了一场辩论。
words.en: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

words.ex: There was a controversy about the new school rules.
words.ex_cn: 关于新校规，人们展开了争论。
words.en: A controversy is a disagreement or argument about something that involves many people and generates strong feelings.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: He tries to negate the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图否认事实。
words.en: If someone negates something, they say that it does not exist or is not true.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.ex: We can utilize solar energy to power the house.
words.ex_cn: 我们可以利用太阳能来为房子供电。
words.en: To utilize something means to use it in a practical or effective way.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.ex: The company will deploy new software next week.
words.ex_cn: 公司将在下周部署新软件。
words.en: To deploy troops or military resources means to organize or position them so that they are ready to be used.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.tr:
v. 避开；躲避
n. 躲避；诡计
words.ex: He dodged the ball quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速躲开了球。
words.en: If you dodge, you move quickly, often to avoid being hit, caught, or seen.

words.ex: He tried to evade the police by driving fast.
words.ex_cn: 他试图通过高速驾驶来逃避警察。
words.en: If you evade something, you find a way of not doing something that you really ought to do.

words.ex: The shopkeeper will evaluate the old watch.
words.ex_cn: 店主将估价这块旧手表。
words.en: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

words.ex: The teacher will assess your homework tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 老师明天会评估你的作业。
words.en: to judge or decide the amount, value, quality, or importance of something

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The teacher will appraise my essay next week.
words.ex_cn: 老师下周会评价我的作文。
words.en: If you appraise something or someone, you consider them carefully and form an opinion about them.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.ex: I consider going to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我考虑明天去公园。
words.en: If you consider something, you think about it carefully.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.ex: He remained passive during the argument.
words.ex_cn: 他在争论中保持被动。
words.en: Accepting or allowing what happens or what others do, without active response or resistance.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: This plan is viable and can be done with little money.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且用很少的钱就能完成。
words.en: If something is viable, it is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.tr: v. 强烈吸引住；使着迷；
words.ex: The magic show fascinated the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演深深吸引了孩子们。
words.en: If something fascinates you, it interests and delights you so much that your thoughts tend to concentrate on it.

words.ex: The bright flowers attract bees.
words.ex_cn: 鲜艳的花朵吸引蜜蜂。
words.en: If something or someone attracts you, they have particular qualities which cause you to like or admire them.

words.tr: v. 招手示意；举手召唤；引诱
words.ex: He beckoned to the boy to come closer.
words.ex_cn: 他向那个男孩招手示意过来。
words.en: If you beckon to someone, you signal to them to come to you, usually by a gesture of your hand.

words.ex: The loud music distract me from my homework.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我无法专心做作业。
words.en: If something distracts you or your attention, it makes you stop concentrating on what you are doing.

words.ex: He showed strong emotion when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，表现出了强烈的情绪。
words.en: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: They rejoice when the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳出来时，他们欢呼。
words.en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.tr:
n. 黑暗；忧郁；幽暗
v. 变阴暗；变忧郁
words.ex: The room was filled with gloom after the power went out.
words.ex_cn: 停电后，房间里一片黑暗。
words.en: Gloom is a feeling of sadness and lack of hope.

words.tr:
n. 研究所；学院；协会；
v. 建立；制定；
words.ex: He works at a research institute.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家研究所工作。
words.en: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. It can also refer to the act of starting something such as a system or an official process.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: He goes to a music academy every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末去音乐学院。
words.en: An academy is a type of school for special training or a society for the advancement of art, science, or literature.

words.tr:
v. 声称；索赔；
n. 声称；索要；
words.ex: He claims that he saw a UFO last night.
words.ex_cn: 他声称自己昨晚看到了不明飞行物。
words.en: If you say that someone claims that something is true, you mean they say that it is true but you are not sure whether or not they are telling the truth.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: He exclaim when he saw the surprise.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到惊喜时，他大喊起来。
words.en: If you exclaim, you say something suddenly and loudly, often because you are surprised, excited, or angry.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.ex: I recognize her face from school.
words.ex_cn: 我从学校认出了她的脸。
words.en: If you recognize someone or something, you know who or what they are because you have seen or heard them before.

words.ex: I recognised my old friend at the station.
words.ex_cn: 我在车站认出了我的老朋友。
words.en: to know someone or something because you have seen or heard him or her or experienced it before

words.ex: Children develop cognitive skills as they grow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在成长过程中发展认知能力。
words.en: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr: n. 专家咨询组；嵌板；仪器板；
words.ex: The government formed a panel to advise on health policy.
words.ex_cn: 政府组建了一个专家咨询组来就卫生政策提供建议。
words.en: A panel is a small group of people who are chosen to do something, for example to discuss something in public or to make a decision.

words.tr: n. 测量仪器；规格；评估；
words.ex: The mechanic used a gauge to check the tire pressure.
words.ex_cn: 机械师用一个测量仪器来检查轮胎气压。
words.en: A gauge is a device that measures the amount or quantity of something and shows the measurement in a form that is easy to read, such as a dial or a digital display.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 索具装备；钻探设备；装备
v. 配备索具；操纵；舞弊
words.ex: He uses a rig to hold the camera steady.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个支架来固定相机。
words.en: To rig something means to arrange or set it up in a particular way, often in a temporary or makeshift manner. It can also refer to the equipment used in drilling for oil or gas, or the sails and ropes on a ship.

words.ex: She bought a new outfit for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一套新衣服。
words.en: An outfit is a set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

words.ex: He bought a repair kit for his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套自行车维修工具。
words.en: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 设施；特色功能；特定场所；资质；
words.ex: The school has a new sports facility.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有一个新的体育设施。
words.en: A facility is a place, building, or service that is designed for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 发展；进步；提前；
adj. 预先的；在前的；
v. 前进；发展；提前；
words.ex: The advance of technology has changed our lives.
words.ex_cn: 科技的发展改变了我们的生活。
words.en: If you advance a cause, interest, or claim, you support it and help it to succeed.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.ex: His memory is very good; he remembers everything.
words.ex_cn: 他的记忆力很好；他什么都记得。
words.en: Memory is the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information.

words.ex: They placed a memorial at the site of the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他们在事故地点放置了一座纪念物。
words.en: A memorial is a structure or event established to remind people of a person or event.

words.ex: They plant trees to commemorate the fallen soldiers.
words.ex_cn: 他们种树以纪念阵亡的士兵。
words.en: To commemorate an important event or person means to remember them by means of a special action, ceremony, or specially created object.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.tr:
n. 意义；感知；理解力；知觉；
v. 感觉到；觉察出；意识到；
words.ex: The story has no sense.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事没有意义。
words.en: A sense is a feeling or awareness about something, or a physical ability such as sight, hearing, touch, taste, or smell.

words.tr: adj. 声名狼藉的；臭名昭著的；
words.ex: He is a notorious thief who stole from many stores.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个声名狼藉的小偷，偷过许多商店。
words.en: Someone or something that is notorious is well known for something bad.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.tr:
n. 账户；叙述；账目；
v. 占…；说明；
words.ex: I opened a bank account last week.
words.ex_cn: 我上周开了一家银行账户。
words.en: An account is a detailed report or description of an event or situation.

words.ex: He put the milk in a carton.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶倒进了硬纸盒里。
words.en: A carton is a box or container usually made of cardboard or plastic, used for holding goods.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.tr:
adj. 当前的；流通的；
n. （水、气、电）流；趋势；
words.ex: The current weather is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 当前的天气非常热。
words.en: belonging to the present time; happening or being used or done now

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.ex: The clever boy solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个聪明的男孩很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: Someone who is clever is intelligent and able to understand things easily or plan things well.

words.ex: He did it for her sake.
words.ex_cn: 他为了她的缘故做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something for the sake of something, you do it for that purpose or in order to achieve that result. You can also say that you do it for something's sake.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr:
n. 提示；
v. 促使；
adj. 迅速的；准时的；
words.ex: The teacher gave a prompt to help students start writing.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了一个提示，帮助学生开始写作。
words.en: If you prompt someone when they stop speaking, you encourage or help them to continue. If you are prompt to do something, you do it without delay or you are not late.

words.tr:
n. 鞭策；
v. 刺激；
words.ex: The competition served as a spur to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 竞争成了推动他更努力工作的鞭策。
words.en: A spur is something that makes you want to do something or that encourages you to do it. It can also refer to a sharp device worn on the heel of a rider's boot to urge a horse forward.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.ex: Please stir the soup before serving.
words.ex_cn: 请在上菜前搅拌一下汤。
words.en: To mix a substance or move it around using a spoon or other object; to cause to move or act; to arouse or excite.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.tr:
n. 标准；
adj. 标准的；规范的；
words.ex: The school has a high standard for homework.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校对作业有很高的标准。
words.en: A standard is a level of quality or achievement, especially a level that is thought to be acceptable.

words.ex: The norm in this school is to arrive on time.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的准则就是准时到校。
words.en: A norm is an official standard or level that organizations are expected to reach.

words.ex: The main criterion for winning is fairness.
words.ex_cn: 获胜的主要标准是公平。
words.en: A criterion is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 金融；财务；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: He works in finance in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约从事金融工作。
words.en: Finance is the management of large amounts of money, especially by governments or large companies.

words.ex: He took out a mortgage to buy his first house.
words.ex_cn: 他申请了一笔抵押贷款来购买他的第一套房子。
words.en: A mortgage is a loan of money which you get from a bank or building society in order to buy a house.

words.ex: The old painting was sold at an auction.
words.ex_cn: 那幅旧画在拍卖会上被卖出了。
words.en: An auction is a public sale where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.

words.tr:
n. 预算；预算金额；
adj. 廉价的；花钱少的；
v. 为 ... 做预算；
words.ex: We made a budget for our vacation.
words.ex_cn: 我们为旅行制定了一个预算。
words.en: A budget is a plan that shows how much money a person or organization will earn and how much they will need or be able to spend.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The speaker will amplify the sound for everyone to hear.
words.ex_cn: 扬声器会放大声音，让每个人都能听到。
words.en: To amplify something means to make it louder, stronger, or more detailed.

words.tr: v. 扩大；膨胀；更充分地阐述；
words.ex: The company plans to expand its business to other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司计划将其业务扩大到其他国家。
words.en: To increase in size, number, or importance, or to make something increase in this way.

words.ex: They will extend the deadline by one week.
words.ex_cn: 他们将截止日期延长一周。
words.en: To extend something means to make it longer or larger, or to spread it over a larger area.

words.ex: Dust particles float in the air.
words.ex_cn: 灰尘微粒漂浮在空气中。
words.en: A particle is a very small piece or amount of something.

words.tr: n. 对应物；相当之物；副本；
words.ex: The CEO's counterpart in China signed the agreement.
words.ex_cn: 中国方面的对应人物签署了协议。
words.en: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.tr:
n. 划分；隔离物；分割
v. 分开；隔开
words.ex: The partition of the room made it more private.
words.ex_cn: 房间的隔断让它更私密了。
words.en: A partition is a wall, screen, or divider that separates one part of a room, vehicle, or other space from another.

words.ex: He will depart tomorrow morning.
words.ex_cn: 他明天早上离开。
words.en: If you depart from a place, you leave it and start a journey to another place.

words.tr:
n. 分数；得分；总谱；乐谱；
v. 得分；
words.ex: He got a high score on the math test.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学考试中得了高分。
words.en: If you score a particular amount or number in a game or test, you achieve that amount or number.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.ex: He loves eating foreign food.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃什么外国食物。
words.en: belonging to or connected with a country that is not your own

words.tr:
n. 外星人；外国人；外侨；
adj. 外国的；陌生的；相异的；
words.ex: The boy saw an alien in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在森林里看到了一个外星人。
words.en: An alien is someone who is not a citizen of the country in which they live, or a creature from outer space.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.ex: The king oppresses the poor people.
words.ex_cn: 国王压迫穷人。
words.en: If someone oppresses people, they treat them cruelly or unfairly and prevent them from having the same rights as other people.

words.ex: He tried to suppress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: To suppress something means to prevent it from being expressed, known, or continuing.

words.ex: He tried to repress his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抑制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you repress a feeling, you deliberately do not express it, often because it is considered unacceptable or inappropriate.

words.tr:
v. 把…归因于；由…引起；
n. 品质；属性；特征；属性；
words.ex: He attributes his success to hard work.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的成功归因于努力工作。
words.en: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

words.tr: v. 贡献；促成；捐献；投稿；
words.ex: He contributes money to the charity.
words.ex_cn: 他向慈善机构捐款。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr: adj. 身体的；物质的；物理的；外观的；
words.ex: He has a physical injury from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在这次事故中受了身体上的伤。
words.en: Relating to the body as opposed to the mind; relating to things that can be seen or touched, as opposed to things that are abstract or imaginary.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.ex: The store sells cheap merchandise.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售廉价商品。
words.en: Goods to be bought and sold.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr: n. 企业联合组织；财团
words.ex: The men formed a syndicate to buy the land.
words.ex_cn: 这些人组成了一个辛迪加来购买土地。
words.en: A syndicate is a group of individuals or organizations combined or making a joint effort to undertake some specific duty or carry out specific transactions or negotiations.

words.tr: n. 优惠券；息票；配给券
words.ex: He used a coupon to buy milk at half price.
words.ex_cn: 他用一张优惠券以半价买了牛奶。
words.en: A coupon is a piece of printed paper that allows you to pay less money than usual for a product, or to get it free.

words.tr: n. 象征物；标志；代金券；代币；
words.ex: The dove is a token of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征物。
words.en: A token is something that represents or stands for something else, especially a piece of metal or plastic that you can use instead of money in some machines or as a symbol of a particular feeling or event.

words.tr: v. 兜售；沿街叫卖； 散播
words.ex: He tries to peddle fake watches on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在街上兜售假手表。
words.en: To peddle goods or ideas means to try to sell them or make them accepted by going from place to place.

words.tr: adj. 赚大钱的；获利多的；
words.ex: He took a lucrative job at a tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他去了一家科技公司做一份赚大钱的工作。
words.en: A lucrative activity or job is one that you can earn a lot of money from.

words.ex: He goes to the mall to buy clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他去商场买衣服。
words.en: A mall is a large enclosed shopping area from which traffic is excluded.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.ex: He acquired a new skill last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了一项新技能。
words.en: If you acquire something, you buy or obtain it for yourself, or someone gives it to you.

words.ex: He worked hard to attain his goals.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以达到他的目标。
words.en: If you attain something, you gain it or achieve it, often after a lot of effort.

words.ex: We derive the answer from the formula.
words.ex_cn: 我们从公式中得到答案。
words.en: If you derive something such as pleasure or benefit from a person or from something, you get it from them.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The painter portrays a happy family in the photo.
words.ex_cn: 这位画家在画中描绘了一个幸福的家庭。
words.en: To portray someone or something means to show or represent them in a painting, film, book, or other artistic work.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: He could discern a small bird in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 他能辨明树上有一只小鸟。
words.en: If you can discern something, you are aware of it and know what it is.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: He fabricates excuses to avoid work.
words.ex_cn: 他编造借口来逃避工作。
words.en: To fabricate means to invent or produce something false in order to deceive someone.

words.ex: He tried to counterfeit money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图伪造货币。
words.en: Made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive or defraud.

words.tr:
n. 锻造车间；
v. 建立（联系等）；
words.ex: The blacksmith works in the forge every morning.
words.ex_cn: 铁匠每天早上都在锻造车间工作。
words.en: To forge something means to create it, especially by using considerable effort or skill. It can also mean to make or produce something, especially with some difficulty or effort. Additionally, it refers to the act of making a copy or imitation of something with the intent to deceive.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr: n. 代表大会；议会；国会；
words.ex: The congress met to discuss new laws.
words.ex_cn: 代表大会召开以讨论新法律。
words.en: A congress is a formal meeting of representatives, as of various nations, to discuss problems or to make decisions.

words.tr: n. 理事会；委员会；议会；
words.ex: The city council made a new rule about recycling.
words.ex_cn: 市政府理事会制定了关于回收的新规定。
words.en: A council is a group of people who are elected to govern a local area such as a city or, in Britain, a county.

words.ex: The committee meets every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 委员会每周一开会。
words.en: A committee is a group of people who are chosen to do a particular job or make decisions on behalf of a larger group.

words.ex: The case will be heard in court next week.
words.ex_cn: 这个案件将于下周在法院审理。
words.en: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

words.ex: The internet is a big network of computers.
words.ex_cn: 互联网是一个庞大的计算机网络。
words.en: A network is a system of lines or channels that cross or connect, or a group of broadcasting stations that connect for the simultaneous broadcast of a program.

words.ex: He uses the web to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用网络来查找信息。
words.en: A web is a thin net made from sticky threads that a spider uses to catch insects.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.ex: The ant moved its antenna to feel the ground.
words.ex_cn: 蚂蚁用它的触角感知地面。
words.en: An antenna is a device that sends and receives radio or television signals. In biology, it refers to the long, thin sensory appendages on the heads of insects and crustaceans.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.tr:
n. 转移；移位；转变；轮班；
v. 变换位置；转移；换（挡）；轮班；
words.ex: The shift of power to the new government was sudden.
words.ex_cn: 权力向新政府的转移是突然的。
words.en: If you shift something or if it shifts, it moves or changes its position slightly. If someone's opinion, attitude, or behaviour shifts, it changes slightly, especially in response to a particular situation or event.

words.tr:
adj. 暗淡的；昏暗的；模糊的
v. （使）变暗淡；（使）变模糊；（使）减弱
words.ex: The room is dim because the lights are off.
words.ex_cn: 房间很暗，因为灯关了。
words.en: If a light or a place is dim, it is not bright or is not lit very strongly.

words.tr: adj. 模糊的；不确定的；无限期的
words.ex: He gave an indefinite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个不确定的答案。
words.en: If you describe something as indefinite, you mean that it has not been decided or defined clearly, or that it has no clear limit or end.

words.tr: adj. 不透明的；难懂的；晦涩的
words.ex: The glass is opaque, so I cannot see through it.
words.ex_cn: 这扇玻璃是不透明的，所以我看不到它后面的东西。
words.en: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.ex: She transcended her fears to speak on stage.
words.ex_cn: 她超越了自己的恐惧，在舞台上发言。
words.en: If something transcends normal limits or boundaries, it goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.tr:
v. 转移；转让；调任；
n. 转移；转让；调任；
words.ex: He will transfer the money to his bank account.
words.ex_cn: 他将把钱转到他的银行账户。
words.en: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

words.tr:
n. 个人；
adj. 个别的；单独的；
words.ex: Each individual has the right to speak freely.
words.ex_cn: 每个人都有权自由发言。
words.en: An individual is a person considered separately from their society or community. As an adjective, it describes something that is single, separate, or unique to a person or thing.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr:
v. 逝去；过去
n. （光阴）逝去
words.ex: Two hours elapsed while he waited for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他等公交车时，两个小时过去了。
words.en: If time elapses, it passes.

words.ex: The expense of the trip was higher than expected.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的费用比预期的要高。
words.en: An expense is the amount of money that you spend on something.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: The survey asks about your gender.
words.ex_cn: 这个调查询问你的性别。
words.en: Gender is the state of being male or female, especially when considered with reference to social and cultural differences, not just biological ones.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: The captive man sat quietly in his cell.
words.ex_cn: 那个被监禁的人安静地坐在牢房里。
words.en: A captive is someone who is being kept as a prisoner or in a confined space, or something that is held or confined.

words.ex: He went to school despite the rain.
words.ex_cn: 尽管下雨，他还是去上学了。
words.en: Without being affected by; in spite of.

words.tr: v. 复制；复印；再做一次；
words.ex: He duplicated the file to save a copy.
words.ex_cn: 他复制了该文件以保存一份副本。
words.en: To duplicate something means to make an exact copy of it.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.tr:
n. 数量；数额；
v. 总计；等于；
words.ex: The amount of water in the bottle is small.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里的水量很少。
words.en: An amount of something is how much there is of it, or how much you have, need, or get.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.ex: He dwells in a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一所小房子里。
words.en: If you dwell on something, especially something unpleasant, you think, speak, or write about it a lot or for quite a long time.

words.ex: He turned the knob to adjust the volume.
words.ex_cn: 他转动旋钮来调节音量。
words.en: A knob is a round handle, or a round switch on a piece of equipment.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.tr:
n. 衣柜；壁橱；贮藏室
adj. 隐藏的
words.ex: He keeps his shirts in the closet.
words.ex_cn: 他把衬衫放在壁橱里。
words.en: A closet is a small room or space in a house or apartment where clothes, shoes, and other items are stored.

words.ex: They booked a hotel suite for their honeymoon.
words.ex_cn: 他们为蜜月预订了一间酒店套房。
words.en: A set of rooms designated for use together, especially in a hotel; a set of musical compositions designed to be performed in a sequence.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.ex: The elite of the city often meet at private clubs.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市的精英经常在私人俱乐部会面。
words.en: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

words.ex: He became the champion of the tennis tournament.
words.ex_cn: 他赢得了网球锦标赛的冠军。
words.en: A champion is someone who has won first prize in a competition, contest, or fight.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: The university has great prestige for its research.
words.ex_cn: 这所大学因其研究而享有很高的声望。
words.en: The widespread respect and admiration felt for someone or something on the basis of a perception of their achievements or quality.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.ex: He will perform the task tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会执行这个任务。
words.en: To perform means to carry out, accomplish, or fulfill an action, task, or function. It can also refer to the act of presenting a form of entertainment, such as a play, concert, or other artistic expression, before an audience.

words.ex: He bullies his little brother every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都欺负他的弟弟。
words.en: To bully someone means to use your strength or power to hurt or frighten them, often forcing them to do something they do not want to do.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.ex: The broken bridge is a menace to drivers.
words.ex_cn: 这座破桥对司机来说是个危险物。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is a menace, you mean that they are likely to cause serious harm.

words.ex: The high fine will deter people from breaking the law.
words.ex_cn: 高额罚款会制止人们违法。
words.en: If something deters you from doing something, it makes you not want to do it or continue doing it.

words.tr:
n. 勒索；敲诈
v. 勒索；讹诈
words.ex: He threatened to tell the truth unless she paid him money — that's blackmail.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁说，除非她付钱，否则就说出真相——这就是敲诈。
words.en: Blackmail is the action of threatening to reveal a secret about someone, unless they do something you want, such as give you money.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.tr:
n. 方法；接近；靠近；路径；
v. 接近；靠近；临近；处理；
words.ex: He used a new approach to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一种新方法来解决问题。
words.en: To come near or nearer to something or someone in distance or time.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: The clearance of trash improved the park's appearance.
words.ex_cn: 清理垃圾改善了公园的外观。
words.en: Clearance refers to the process of removing or getting rid of something, or the space that is needed for one thing to move past another. It can also refer to the permission given for something to happen or be done.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: Can you clarify your answer?
words.ex_cn: 你能澄清一下你的答案吗？
words.en: To clarify something means to make it easier to understand by explaining it more clearly.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.tr: v. 设防御工事；加强；增加营养物
words.ex: The soldiers fortify the hill with walls and trenches.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在山上用墙壁和战壕设防御工事。
words.en: To strengthen a place with defensive works so as to protect it against attack; to strengthen or invigorate someone mentally or physically.

words.ex: Exercise can elevate your mood.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提升你的情绪。
words.en: To elevate something means to raise it to a higher position or level, either physically or in terms of its status or importance.

words.ex: She works out to augment her strength.
words.ex_cn: 她锻炼以增强力量。
words.en: If you augment something, you make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.

words.ex: The argument started small but soon escalate.
words.ex_cn: 争论起初很小，但很快逐步升高。
words.en: If a bad situation escalates or if someone or something escalates it, it becomes greater in size, seriousness, or intensity.

words.ex: Exercise can bolster your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以增强你的健康。
words.en: If you bolster something such as someone's confidence or courage, you increase it. A bolster is also a long, firm pillow.

words.ex: The car will accelerate when you press the gas.
words.ex_cn: 当你踩油门时，汽车会加速。
words.en: To accelerate means to start to go faster or to make something start to go faster.

words.ex: He strives to finish his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天努力完成作业。
words.en: If you strive to do something or strive for something, you make a great effort to do it or get it.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.tr:
adj. 大规模的；大量的；
n. 大量；质量；块；群；团；
words.ex: The company launched a mass production line to meet demand.
words.ex_cn: 该公司启动了大规模生产线以满足需求。
words.en: A mass is a large amount of something that has no particular shape or arrangement.

words.ex: The magnitude of this decision will affect everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定的重要性会影响每个人。
words.en: Magnitude refers to the great size or extent of something, or the importance of something.

words.ex: A multitude of people attended the festival.
words.ex_cn: 大量的人参加了这个节日。
words.en: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.ex: He ate a chunk of cheese for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一大块奶酪。
words.en: A chunk of something is a large piece or amount of it.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.ex: Parents should foster good habits in children.
words.ex_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好习惯。
words.en: To foster something means to encourage and promote its development.

words.tr:
n. 收费；负责；指控；
v. 收费；充电；
words.ex: The hotel charge is $50 per night.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的收费是每晚50美元。
words.en: If you charge someone, you ask them to pay an amount of money for something that you have sold to them or done for them.

words.ex: He will sue the company for damages.
words.ex_cn: 他将起诉这家公司要求赔偿。
words.en: To sue means to start a legal case against someone, usually to claim money from them because they have caused you harm or loss.

words.ex: The court will prosecute him for theft.
words.ex_cn: 法院将因盗窃罪起诉他。
words.en: To prosecute means to institute legal proceedings against someone or to carry on a legal action against a defendant in a court of law. It also means to continue with or carry on an activity or enterprise.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: He is an intermediate student in English.
words.ex_cn: 他是英语的中级学生。
words.en: An intermediate stage, level, or position is one that occurs between two other stages, levels, or positions.

words.ex: The police will interrogate the suspect tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 警察明天会审问嫌疑人。
words.en: To interrogate someone means to ask them a lot of questions for a long time in order to get information, sometimes using threats.

words.ex: There is little intercourse between the two villages.
words.ex_cn: 这两个村庄之间很少交往。
words.en: Intercourse refers to communication or dealings between individuals or groups, or sexual activity between people.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: The pattern of the wallpaper is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 墙纸的图案非常简单。
words.en: A pattern is the repeated or regular way in which something happens or is done.

words.ex: The game simulates real traffic conditions.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏模拟了真实的交通状况。
words.en: To simulate is to create a model or representation of a situation, process, or system for the purpose of study, analysis, or training. It involves imitating the conditions of a real event or environment to understand its effects or to practice responses to it.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.tr: adj. 虚拟的；几乎的；实际上的；事实上的；
words.ex: He played a virtual game on his computer.
words.ex_cn: 他在电脑上玩了一个虚拟游戏。
words.en: If you describe something as virtual, you mean that it is so nearly true that for most purposes it can be regarded as true.

words.tr:
adj. 理想的；
n. 理想；典范；
words.ex: This is the ideal place to relax.
words.ex_cn: 这是放松的理想地方。
words.en: An ideal is a principle or value that one actively pursues as a goal, often in the context of ethics or morality.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.ex: He can foretell the weather by looking at the sky.
words.ex_cn: 他可以通过观察天空来预知天气。
words.en: To tell or indicate beforehand; predict.

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.ex: The herald announced the king's arrival.
words.ex_cn: 传令官宣布了国王的到来。
words.en: A herald is someone who carries or proclaims important news; a forerunner or harbinger.

words.ex: I anticipate rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我预料明天会下雨。
